subject: THE PANHELLENIC UNION OF LICENSED AERONAUTICAL TELECOMMUNICATION
text:
A4358/26 NOTAMN
Q) LGGG/QXXXX/IV/NBO/W /000/999/3658N02430E341
A) LGGG B) 2611242201 C) 2611252200
E) THE PANHELLENIC UNION OF LICENSED AERONAUTICAL TELECOMMUNICATION 
OFFICERS  (AFISO) PARTICIPATES IN THE ANNOUNCED 24H STRIKE OF ADEDY. 
 THEREFORE, ACCORDING TO LABOR LEGISLATION THE FLW FLT ARE FULLY 
UNAFFECTED:
1.ALL A/C OVERFLYING ATHINAI FIR/HELLAS UIR.
2.ALL STATE A/C PARTICIPATING IN SCHEDULED MILITARY EXERCISES.
3.EMERGENCY-HAF OPS-HOSP-MERCY-VIP (HEAD OF STATE OR PRIME
MINISTERS).
4.FLT SUPPORTING EMERGENCY SITUATIONS (E.G. SAR).
FOR THE REST OF THE FLT, DUE TO THE ABV WORK SUSPENSION
POSSIBLE LACK OF ADEQUATE STAFF MAY OCCUR IN THE FLW AREAS
OF OPERATION:
1.AFIS AT THE FLW AP:
LGKP, LGPA, LGSO, LGNX, LGKC, LGML, LGLE, LGKA, LGKZ, LGKS, LGKJ, 
LGPL, LGIK, LGST, LGKY.
2.AERONAUTICAL FIXED SERVICE AND AERONAUTICAL BROADCASTING SERVICE.

AIRMEN,AIRLINES ARE ADVISED TO COMMUNICATE DIRECTLY WITH ABV
AIRPORTS MANAGERS PRIOR DEPARTURE TO BE INFORMED ABOUT SPECIFIC
AP SITUATION.)
